scenes.title: Left Arcuate Fasciculus · source probability

scenes.note: Original source file: Arcuate_Fasciculus_L.nii.gz. The probability overlay uses the original fraction values. The 3D surface and binary overlay use the inclusive 0.20 display threshold; overlapping memberships remain independent. The matching MRI consists of an exact original template subarray, with its voxel positions retained.
